held.permission: Your role may not do this ({permission}).

issue.state: Only a draft goes to the workshop; this order is {status}.
issue.noOperation: The order has no operation yet: add what the workshop does from the work order’s routing.
issue.noFee: Line {line} ({code}) has no fee per piece: type it before the order goes to the workshop.
issue.noFeeHidden: A line has no fee per piece yet: a buyer types it before the order goes out.
issue.noDate: The order has no return date: say when the goods are due back.
issue.workOrder: Work order {number} is not released or running: no work goes out for it now.

reopen.state: Only an order sent to the workshop goes back to draft; this one is {status}.

cancel.state: Only a draft or a sent order whose goods never left is cancelled; this one is {status}.

held.out: Part of the kit or the pieces are out already: take them back first.

close.state: The order closes once every piece is back; it is {status}.

send.draft: The kit goes out once the order is sent to the workshop: issue it first.
send.state: Nothing more goes out: the order is {status}.
send.workOrder: Work order {number} is not released or running: nothing goes out for it now.
send.nothing: Everything planned has gone out: no kit line and no piece is left to send.

receive.nothingOut: Nothing has gone out yet: goods come back once the kit or the pieces are at the workshop.
receive.state: Nothing more comes back: the order is {status}.

held.workshopInactive: The workshop is blocked or archived: no work goes to it.
held.locationArchived: The workshop’s stock location is archived: make an active one in Warehouse › Locations.
held.currency: The order has no valid currency.
held.server: The server holds it: it is not possible to {act} now. Reload the order and check its tabs.

problem.read: The server didn't answer as expected. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not see or do this.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
problem.gone: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.invalid: Something in it was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries at once. Wait a moment and try again.

noAccess.title: Not for your role
noAccess.body: Subcontract orders need purchasing.view: ask an administrator for it.

tile.balanceLater: The material balance per order comes with a later step: its count is not known yet.

list.search: Search number, workshop or work order

empty.title: No subcontract orders
empty.body: Send a work order’s outside operations (sewing, embroidery, armour pockets, finishing) to a workshop: the order holds the kit, the DDT and what comes back.

noMatch.title: No order matches
noMatch.body: Nothing in this view matches the search. Clear the filters to see every open order.

stock.title: Stock at subcontractors
stock.intro: Each workshop is a stock location: our material there by lot, still in our books until it comes back in the garments.
stock.daysOutLater: Days out (ageing) come with a later step.
stock.empty: None of our material is at a workshop
stock.emptyBody: Material goes to a workshop with a subcontract order’s kit, on its DDT for work on our behalf.
stock.noMatch: No stock line matches the search.
stock.truncated: Only the first lines are shown: filter by workshop to see the rest.
stock.ours: Still ours: it stays in our books while the workshop holds it.

new.title: New subcontract order
new.workOrderHint: Released or running work orders; the ones whose routing sends work out come with their outside steps.
new.noWorkOrder: No released or running work order matches.
new.noOutsideSteps: No outside step in its routing
new.operationsHint: Pick them from the work order’s routing; each sends every garment not already on a live order.
new.inHouse: Done in house in the routing
new.full: Every piece is on live orders already
new.workshopHint: The routing’s workshop is the default. “Qualified only” comes with the supplier qualification (W2b): today an active subcontractor.
new.noLocation: {workshop} has no stock location on this site yet: make one (kind Subcontractor) in Warehouse › Locations first.
new.locationLater: Its stock location on the site is found when the order is made.
new.returnDateHint: Empty: the routing’s transit days from today, the workshop’s closed days skipped.
new.planKit: Plan the kit from the work order’s materials
new.planKitHint: Leather tracked by the hide goes cut, as bundles: it is not a kit line.

held.workshop: Pick the workshop: the operations you picked name none.
held.pieces: Each operation sends from 1 piece up to the pieces still free.

new.number: The number comes from the series when the draft is made.
new.after: The draft opens on Operations & quantities: pieces per size and the fee save cell by cell.

refused.location: {workshop} has no active stock location on the work order’s site: make one in Warehouse › Locations first.
refused.pieces: Some pieces are already on another live order: lower the pieces and try again.
refused.workOrder: The work order is no longer released or running.
refused.workshop: The workshop is not an active subcontractor of this company.

new.ordersOf: Already out for this work order: {orders}
